build: E4, Successions (#90 section 9, #102). Stage 1, the engine and what a plan stores: LRFSuccession.planRun works out a run of successions without changing the plan (one whole bed a sowing, every so many days or to an amount a week, the spacing found for an amount, the last sowing's overshoot said, a frost date marking and never stopping a sowing, field dates, closed houses and room still stopping one, what has no bed said with the gardens that have room); a plan keeps lrfNext.runs and each planting of a run carries run { id, n, gap }, both taken whole by the merge; LRFApp.addRun adds a run as one step with one Undo, refused whole if any planting cannot be added, and LRFApp.removeRun takes a run's record out, its plantings kept as plain plantings unless asked to go with it. A copy of a planting is in no run. Nothing on the page changes in this stage; stage 2 builds the Successions tab and takes the old series panel away. No figure of an existing plan moves.

changes.did: Successions have a tab of their own: plan a run of whole beds every so many days, or to an amount a week, and it is kept as one run.
steps: Open Successions, choose a crop and A weekly amount, and type how many a week: it says one whole bed every so many days, and the weeks against the amount.
Press Add: the plantings are added as one step, and one Undo takes them all back.
The run is then in the list at the left, and opens to its plantings.
